why: an export archive carrying session_state — the nine resume fields of a lesson in flight. Importing it drops the learner into a half-finished session from another device, against content that may not even be installed; and an archive that quietly omits it without the manifest saying so is indistinguishable from a bug, which is why the invariant has two halves and this fixture names both.
mustNotBe: a session_state key anywhere in the archive; an export plan whose excludedTables omits it, so a caller has to remember; or a manifest that excludes it SILENTLY, which a reader cannot tell apart from a writer that forgot.
addedNote: Added at P1 integration: the data lane's corpus had twelve files and not this one. Descriptive rather than executable because planExport's return carries paths and byte budgets that no committed JSON should pin.
